title: Choose your client API
summary: Start with the protocol your application sends. Native forwarding and translation have different compatibility boundaries.

cards.title: OpenAI Chat Completions
cards.summary: Review API forwarding and build requirements. Development includes a Chat Completions quickstart with complete configuration.

cards.title: Anthropic Messages
cards.summary: Choose native Messages forwarding or translation to a Chat Completions backend; review streaming and compatibility limits.

cards.title: Responses and Conversations
cards.summary: Distinguish upstream passthrough from experimental managed state and tool execution. Check build features before configuring.

title: Connect a provider
summary: Match the client protocol to your upstream, credentials, and selected build. Provider adapters do not imply support for every provider operation.

cards.title: Choose a client and provider
cards.summary: Review capabilities and build requirements. Development adds a client/provider decision table covering credentials and compatibility.

cards.title: Azure, Vertex, and Bedrock
cards.summary: Review the provider adapters and their prerequisites before selecting a configuration.

title: Add gateway behavior
summary: Choose a task, follow its guide, then use the filter reference for exact settings. External services and optional builds may be required.

cards.title: Route models and providers
cards.summary: Explore model routing and selection; Development adds a complete alias and provider-routing recipe.

cards.title: Guardrails and token usage
cards.summary: Screen requests with an external guardrail service and inspect usage. Development combines these in an operator recipe.

cards.title: Discover filters and composition
cards.summary: Find capabilities, filter settings, and the pipeline composition needed for your task.

cards.title: MCP, A2A, and agentic flows
cards.summary: Separate protocol routing and brokering from model-driven tool execution and experimental managed flows.

cards.title: Operate and troubleshoot
cards.summary: Plan deployment and capacity. Development adds an operations, observability, and upgrade checklist.
